title: Platforms Overview
meta_description: Eight proprietary platforms encode our delivery patterns as configurable products — governance, security controls and evidence generation arrive pre-built.

blocks.x: Eight proprietary platforms encode our delivery patterns as configurable products — governance, security controls and evidence generation arrive pre-built.

Platforms are how Dataq Software turns consulting into leverage: each platform ships with the controls, audit evidence production and delivery patterns our teams have standardized. Clients start from a configured 80 percent baseline and spend their budget on the 20 percent that is genuinely theirs.

items: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds: with a full evidence trail for each decision.
Dataq Forge — Data & Lakehouse Engineering Platform
The governed data estate every AI program needs.
Dataq Swarm — Agentic AI Orchestration Platform
Many agents operating as one governed, measurable workforce.
Dataq Sentinel — Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform
Security controls for people, machines and models, with evidence collected continuously.
Dataq Twinverse — Digital Twin & IoT Intelligence Platform
Sensor data feeds a living model of your plant, fleet or field estate, and the model drives action.
Dataq Quanta — Quantum & Advanced Compute Suite
Optimization with baselines, benchmarks and a documented verdict.
Dataq Ledger — Distributed Trust & Tokenization Platform
A shared, verifiable record with controls regulators accept — permissioned networks that stand up to supervision.
Dataq Compass — Responsible AI & Governance Platform
Model governance your risk committee and regulator can review.

blocks.x: How platforms are used in engagements

Most programs combine two or three platforms: a decision program lands Nexus on Forge rails; an agentic program lands Swarm under Compass governance; an industrial program lands Twinverse with Sentinel segmentation. Each platform page carries Overview, Architecture & Trust and Industry Use Cases.
Explore a platform — or book a technical briefing with the platform team.
